Helicone AI is built for answering the questions that start showing up once LLM features hit production: what’s costing money, what’s slow, and what’s breaking for real users. Eden AI

Eden AI

5.0 ·

Choose Eden AIif... [...] It’s compelling when you need request-level visibility into usage, latency, and spend without heavy infrastructure work. The integration is intentionally low-friction, so teams can start capturing meaningful traces and metrics quickly and iterate based on actual traffic patterns.

Helicone also shines as a debugging tool: it helps surface edge cases, regressions, and prompt changes that correlate with higher costs or worse responses. Built-in caching can further reduce spend, making it useful even when routing isn’t the main goal.

If your priority is operational maturity—monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance management—Helicone is often a better complement or replacement than a “free quota” router, especially as volume grows.
